itens.trecho: Score: 5/10 — A Promising Foundation Crumbling Under Its Own Weight I would have given Season 1 an 8/10. It was a compelling mystery box scifi series, character forward, claustrophobic, and packed with enough WTF intrigue to keep you hooked. There was an expectation that Season 2 would build on that momentum and elevate it to a 9. That didn't happen.

I think I'm done with this show after Season 3 Episode 1. To echo the words of the late Bernard, "I know the who, but I don't know the why, and I don't fucking care." We've done the amnesia thing already.

First of all, let me tell you that this show is based on a book. So, kudos and all praise to the author of the book for such an amazing story. Now, about show... Show itself isn't bad. It's interesting, but sadly it's infected with DEI woke propaganda.
